declared_before_scoring: 2026-11-14, after API/readout probes only (exp-results/genesis-rigid-20261114/preflight); no task metric was computed before this file was written.
scope: Every task with completed SAP and MuJoCo results except Newton's cradle (idealised v3 and GAUGE real v4.1), Cassie, round socket, GLIDE and DENSE. Genesis + IPC is a separate later registry.
selection_policy: Same as the task manifest: B=1 = Genesis native defaults; candidates 2-5 below are fixed now; select on selection cells only with the task's existing gate/loss/wall-time rule; freeze; run the unchanged held-out matrix with R=20.

candidate_rules.B1: No numerical contact/solver setting: RigidOptions() defaults and Genesis default geom sol_params (timeconst from RigidOptions.constraint_timeconst=0.01 s, dampratio 1, solimp 0.9/0.95/0.001/0.5/2). Physical inputs (geometry, mass, inertia, friction, gravity, dt, joints, inputs) are always set from the manifest.
candidate_rules.parameterisation: Genesis accepts only positive timeconst (no direct stiffness/damping) and floors every contact's mixed timeconst at 2*dt. Where the MuJoCo Warp candidate is direct (k, b), the Genesis candidate is the exact equivalent tc=2/b, dr=b/(2 sqrt k) (MuJoCo and Genesis share b=2/(dmax tc), k=1/(dmax^2 tc^2 dr^2)); b=0 uses b=0.02 1/s because dampratio=0 is forbidden. Any floor that Genesis applies is recorded in compiled.geoms_sol_params / min_contact_timeconst_s and reported, not hidden.
candidate_rules.unavailable_mujoco_options: Genesis 1.4.6 has no solreffriction, no implicit or RK4 integrator and no direct (negative) solref; candidates that used them in MuJoCo are mapped to the nearest declared Genesis knob as listed per task.

tasks.mapping: identical to the MuJoCo Warp set (solimp dmin=dmax).

k is the MuJoCo pair stiffness k_pair: ground pair s=(1-0.9)k/m, box-box pair 2s, critically damped (tc=1/sqrt(s), dr=1). Genesis mixes the two geoms' sol_params by their mean, so box geoms carry the box-box value and the ground geom 2*ground-target minus it, giving both pair targets exactly. MuJoCo candidate 2's solreffriction tc=4ms has no Genesis counterpart and is dropped.

amendments.change: Candidates with noslip>0 use cone=pyramidal instead of the elliptic default of the non-native settings.
amendments.reason: Genesis 1.4.6 raises 'The elliptic friction cone is not supported with the noslip solver.' at build. Only engine-imposed; at the time of the change the only scored output was three-box candidate 1 (native default, unaffected) and pinch candidate 1 (native default, unaffected). Both tasks are rerun in full under this revision.
